title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Descent. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Descent
options.lineage: the Pattaya aquarium tunnel, and light falling off with depth
options.thesis: The whole archive as one dive from noon daylight to a sky with no floor, ordered by the light each photo actually caught.
materials: ground colour that drains with scroll depth
a light-meter rail reading each photo's real EV from EXIF
options.viewport: Brightest frame of the archive full-bleed on a pale daylight ground, title set into the sky, the EV gauge already lit at the edge.
options.risk: The colour drain has to stay subtle or it fights the photographs; EV must come from real EXIF, never estimated.

raised.raise: The gauge draws its whole EV scale in ghost ticks; only the current reading lights.
The ground is one fully committed field at every depth, never a neutral grey card.
Gravity rules: one vertical axis, every chapter hangs from it.
Type and photograph are two layers that scroll at different rates.
Every photograph leads with the image and flips to its facts: lens, exposure, the hour it was made.

options.label: Almanac of Light
options.lineage: sunrise tables, ephemerides and printed almanacs
options.thesis: The archive filed by hour of light, from first light to astronomical twilight, as a printed almanac.
options.viewport: A sunrise photograph with the day's light table set beside it like a printed almanac page.
options.risk: Familiar: editorial tables on ivory is where most photography sites in this category already land.

options.label: Mesophotic Dive
options.lineage: technical deep-dive logs and dive computers
options.thesis: A literal dive profile: surface, thermocline, reef wall, no floor.
options.viewport: Turquoise surface frame with a depth axis already descending on the left.
options.case: Shares the descent grammar; loses on audience, since visitors identify with photographs, not diving.
options.risk: Reads as an ocean theme pasted over dogs, roads and temples.

options.label: Seven-Segment Clock
options.thesis: Every caption lit in one eight-cell segment mask.
options.viewport: Four red digits over a black field.
options.case: Fuses poorly: red LED glow competes with the photographs.
options.kept: Unlit cells are designed too: the EV gauge shows its whole scale in ghost ticks.

options.label: Risograph System
options.thesis: Misregistered fluorescent inks on warm paper.
options.case: Fuses poorly: fluoro inks would recolour the photographs.
options.kept: Total palette commitment at page scale.
options.risk: Makes photography look like zine art.

options.label: Glaze River Shelf
options.thesis: Samples in a row, glaze running by gravity.
options.viewport: A shelf of glazed cups with recipe cards.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no relationship to the archive.
options.kept: Gravity sets the reading order: one vertical axis.

options.label: Riso Zine Cover
options.thesis: Two ink layers sliding out of register.
options.case: Fuses poorly: overprint destroys photographic colour.
options.kept: Two layers moving independently: type against photograph.

options.label: Seed Packet Rack
options.thesis: Painted promise on the front, instructions on the back.
options.viewport: A rack of packets ranked by season.
options.case: Fuses poorly: gouache illustration has no place beside photographs.
options.kept: Front leads with the promise, back holds the facts: image first, EXIF on the flip.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark photography portfolio: black ground, large serif titles, masonry grid, lightbox.
canonCard.viewport: Full-bleed hero photograph with a large serif name over it.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every photographer's site by design.
